dialogue.speaker: Sarah
dialogue.text: I heard you are thinking about relocating to another country. Is that true?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Yes, I received a job offer abroad, and it is a great opportunity.

dialogue.speaker: Sarah
dialogue.text: Congratulations! But that is a big decision. Are you nervous?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Very. I will need a visa, and I have to find an apartment from a distance.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Leaving my family and friends. I think I will feel homesick at first.

dialogue.speaker: Sarah
dialogue.text: Many expats say the first months are the hardest because of culture shock.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: I have heard that, so I am trying to learn about local customs before I go.

dialogue.speaker: Sarah
dialogue.text: That is wise. Will you learn the language as well?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Yes, I have already started, and it will help me adapt faster.

dialogue.speaker: Sarah
dialogue.text: What if you do not like it there?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Then I can come back after a year. I do not see it as a final decision.

dialogue.speaker: Sarah
dialogue.text: That is a healthy attitude. Contracts can be broken, but experience stays.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Exactly. Even if it is difficult, I will learn a lot about myself.

dialogue.speaker: Sarah
dialogue.text: Please keep in touch and tell us everything.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: I promise. You can all visit me once I am settled in.
